proposal_text: Add per-customer refusal rate trending and alerting to the dashboard. Currently, refusals are tracked period-over-period but there is no automated alert when a single customer's refusal rate spikes disproportionately. This period, Acme Oy accounted for 53% of the total refusal increase (9 of 17 additional refusals) while representing only 17% of the fleet. A per-customer refusal rate threshold alert would surface this kind of concentration earlier. Additionally, consider adding refusal reason categorization (no-match vs duplicate-match vs non-numeric) to distinguish data-quality drift from schema changes.
